children: The American Petroleum Institute reportedly shows a draw of 4.93M barrels of oil in U.S. commercial stockpiles for the week ending October 16, after inventories fell by more than 11M barrels in the previous week.
Gasoline inventories reportedly show a draw of 2M barrels for the week, distillate inventories reportedly show a draw of 2.6M barrels, and Cushing inventories reportedly show a build of 936K barrels.
The Energy Information Administration is scheduled to release its weekly U.S. petroleum supply report on Wednesday, with the average of analysts surveyed by
forecasting domestic commercial crude stocks would fall by 300K barrels, while gasoline inventories were seen finishing unchanged and distillate inventories were expected to fall by 1.3M barrels.
